To make reservations, please contact the pool you would like to reserve directly.

## Swim Tests
Red Cross standardized safety water competency sequence.

Swim tests may be administered to assess group members' swimming abilities. In order to be eligible to participate in certain activities or swim in certain areas, group members must demonstrate the minimal level of swimming ability required. For example, to be eligible to swim in deep water, group members should have at least a minimum level of water competency. A swim test based on the Red Cross water competency sequence would require group members to perform the following five critical water safety skills in sequence:

1. Step or jump into water over your head.
2. Return to the surface and float or tread water for 1 minute.
3. Turn around in a full circle and find an exit.
4. Swim 25 yards to the exit.
5. Exit from the water without using the stairs or a ladder.

# Recreational Equipment Checkout & Rentals

## Recreational Equipment Checkout & Rentals Catalogs
- MCB Camp Lejeune

## Reservations
Reservations can be made up to one (1) year in advance for any item. Items can be reserved for any length of time.

Authorized patrons for REIS are Active Duty, reservists on Active Duty, and their dependents, and DoD authorized personnel. Military/DoD ID cards must be presented at time of reservation and/or at time of reservation pickup.

All reservations for equipment require a 50% deposit of the entire rental amount at the time of reservation to hold the item for date(s) requested. Reservations of equipment for items less than $15 must be paid in full at the time of reservation. Reservations will not be confirmed without payment. Reservations taken over the phone may be paid by credit card.

Remaining balances on reserved items must be paid in full at the time of, or prior to, item pick-up. Persons with unpaid balances will not be permitted to take reserved item.

## Cancellation Policy
Cancellations/Changes will be accepted for full refunds up to 48 hours prior to reservation pick-up. Cancellations and/or Changes within 48 hours (two days) of reservation will result in forfeiture of the deposit. Customers who originally paid in cash may receive a cash refund if the total amount is less than $100.

## Return Policy
All items must be returned on the due date indicated by the assigned return time. Normal rental length is one (1) day from time of pick up. If the expected return time occurs when the facility is closed for the day, the adjusted return time will be by no later than two (2) hours from the time the facility opens on the next business day. Failure to return on time will result in items being assessed a late fee.

## Checkout Procedures
**Distance Policy**

MCCS REIS will allow patrons to take towable items a maximum of 50 miles. Patrons wishing to take items farther than 50 miles will be required to sign a waiver acknowledging the patron will assume all expenses incurred to return the item should the item have malfunctions. MCCS REIS will not reimburse patrons who have items outside the 50-mile limit for towing, repairs, or other costs associated with damages that are not the direct responsibility of REIS.

**Equipment Check-Out Times**

- **Checkout Hours:** Equipment checkouts are available **only during normal posted business hours**.
- **Checkout Time:** Customers must allow **at least 30 minutes** for all equipment checkouts, including trailer inspections and hook-ups.
- **Rental Period:** Standard rental lengths are **24 hours** from the time of pick-up.

pages.text:
# All-Marine Sports

All-Marine Sports provides elite Marine athletes the opportunity to compete in higher level competitions to include Armed Forces Championships, National Championships, Conseil International du Sport Militaire (CISM) Championships, and the Olympics.

## Coaching Opportunities
Support elite Marine athletes as coaches and mentors.

Whether you're a passionate coach looking to shape the next generation of Marine athletes or a competitor driven to perform at the highest level, All-Marine Sports is seeking dedicated individuals who embody the Marine Corps values of Honor, Courage, and Commitment. Submit your application to AllMarineSports@usmc-mccs.org today and answer the call where preparation meets opportunity.

## Standard Test Events
Scores for the following events are required by applicants.

Click on the event name for more information and how to correctly perform the event.

## 3RM Deadlift
- [3RM Deadlift](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-4qRntuXBSc) – Video

## Broad Jump
- [Broad Jump](https://www.topendsports.com/testing/tests/longjump.htm) - Website
- [Execution Broad Jump](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/NVEbtq14CZ4) - Video

## Pro-Agility
- [Pro-Agility](https://www.scienceforsport.com/pro-agility-5-10-5-test/) - Website
- [Execution Pro-Agility](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VJF5ZEiwU4Y) - Website

## Running
Most current running times for:

- Three mile
- 880 yard

## Additional Opportunities
Opportunities for elite athletes to compete in sports.

## Athletes of the Year
The Marine Corps is searching for its top Marine athletes. Marines who have excelled in intramural, varsity, All-Marine, national, and international competitions will be considered for the 2025 Male and Female Athletes of the Year.

Competitions must comply with the amateur regulations within nationally recognized governing bodies or affiliated organizations within the US Olympic Committee. Applications must include a professional biography encompassing the Marine's calendar year accomplishments in the sport and professional Marine Corps background.

Athletes must provide published or final results, such as time and scores associated with the sport the applicant participated in within the 2025 calendar year. Please download the application and email the completed form to AllMarineSports@usmc-mccs.org.

All applications are due to HQMC Semper Fit no later than February 16, 2026. The applicant's commanding officer (O5 level Command or higher) must endorse the application.

## U.S. Armed Forces Sports
The Armed Forces Sports (AFS) program was officially established in 1948 as the Inter-service Sports Council (ISSC). The AFS program offers 25 men and women team and individual sports; annually conducts 16 Armed Forces Sports Championships and 9 qualifying events/Trial Camps; participates in 9 U.S. national championships and 16 CISM Military World Championships. Visit the [AFS website](http://armedforcessports.defense.gov/About/).

## Conseil International du Sport Militaire (CISM)
CISM is the second largest multi-sport discipline organization after the International Olympic Committee. They represent the highest level of military athletic competitiveness and organize various sporting events for the Armed Forces of their 136 member countries.

## Applications
Submit your completed application to compete as an elite athlete.

NOTE: Applications MUST be viewed in Adobe Acrobat. It will not be viewable in a web browser.

- [All-Marine Sports Application](https://lejeunenewriver.usmc-mccs.org/modules/media/?do=download&id=db4f74b2-4d78-46ce-9f7e-05a5fe5e0007&v=1)
- [Elite Warrior Athlete Application](https://lejeunenewriver.usmc-mccs.org/modules/media/?do=download&id=eb9a4191-4a05-4ebe-870a-f1a9574995f3&v=1)
- [Athletes Of The Year](https://lejeunenewriver.usmc-mccs.org/modules/media/?do=download&id=0069c1c0-dd65-4ecc-8a95-091974e8dfd3&v=1)

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Quick answers to common questions.

## Athletic Directors
**Q: What policy governs All-Marine Sports?**

A: DoD Directive 1330.4 allows Marines to participate in Armed Forces, National, and International sports activities.

**Q: Who is eligible for the All-Marine Sports Program?**

A: The total force, with the exception of Inactive Ready Reservist (IRR), are eligible to participate on All-Marine Sports teams (active duty and active reserve). Reservist must be placed on orders (ADOS/similar) by their command to participate and receive TAD funds for travel from HQMC.

**Q: Who pays for the TAD?**

A: HQMC All-Marine Sports will fund all travel (flights/rentals/lodging/meals and incidentals) for Trial Camps, Armed Forces and higher level competition.

**Q: What happens if a Marine is selected to an All-Marine Trial Camp?**

A: All-Marine Sports generates a selection message and sends it to each Marine selected. Each Marine will be responsible for creating their DTS authorization and signing it so that All-Marine Sports can approve the travel. Government Travel Card use is mandatory for required travel and centrally billed accounts will not be authorized.

**Q: What if my Commander needs a Marine back early from an All-Marine Sports competition?**

A: If the Commander needs a Marine back early for mission requirements, the All-Marine Sports Office will attempt to make travel arrangements to have the Marine back within 24 hours. This return cost may be the responsibility of the command.

**Q: If selected will a Marine receive PCS orders or change of MOS?**

A: This is a short term Temporary Assigned Duty (TAD) opportunity (4 days to 2 months depending on the sport and your selection for higher competitions).

**Q: When will Marines be notified to "Try Out"?**

A: Selections will be made to attend Trial Camp from the information provided in the applications and contacting references. Notifications will be made approximately two (2) weeks following the application deadline through a selection message. Marines must be in peak physical condition to compete immediately.

**Q: What do Marines need to bring to Trial Camp?**

A: Specific requirements for each Trial Camp vary by sport and location. The head coach will reach out to the Marines selected prior to travel and provide a list of required items. In addition, each Marine is required to bring a pair of khaki pants, belt, and dress shoes.

**Q: Does the All-Marine Running Program have a Trial Camp?**

A: No, the All-Marine Running Program does not have an official Trial Camp.

**Q: Can a Marine participate in a Trial Camp if on leave?**

A: No, participation while in a leave status is prohibited.

**Q: Can a Marine participate while on Terminal Leave status?**

A: No, you have to be in an active status to participate.

**Q: Can a Marine take leave on the front or back of TAD?**

A: Marines must obtain Commander's approval for leave prior to creating DTS orders (except for emergency situations) and include leave details in DTS authorization.

**Q: What if my question is not answered here?**

A: You can send an email to: AllMarineSports@usmc-mccs.org

## Athletes
**Q: What sports are included in the All-Marine Sports Program?**

A: All sports listed on the [All-Marine Sports calendar](https://armedforcessports.defense.gov/Events-Calendar/) are currently offered.

**Q: My sport is not listed, can it be added?**

A: The inventory of sports is determined by Armed Forces Sports calendar, as established by the Armed Forces Sports Council, for each year.

**Q: How do I apply for All-Marine Sports?**

A: Download the application and submit the completed and signed application to AllMarineSports@usmc-mccs.org. Submit your application NLT the closing date identified on the MARADMIN.

**Q: What do I do if the application doesn't populate when I click start application:**

A: Click the download button in the upper right of the screen and save the document to your computer, then open it from your computer.

**Q: When are applications due?**

A: In order to be considered for the first/primary selections for a Trial Camp, your application must be submitted to AllMarineSports@usmc-mccs.org prior to the deadline noted. Specific deadline dates are listed on the application site and corresponding MARADMIN.

**Q: Can I send additional paperwork with my application?**

A: Yes. You can send supporting documents with your application.

**Q: I've filled out the application now what do I do?**

A: Based on the information provided on your application, All-Marine Sports will select candidates to participate in Trial Camp. (Make sure your application is complete, decisions are made based on what is on the application). Submitting an application does not guarantee selection to Trial Camp.

(The Athletes tab also repeats the policy, eligibility, TAD funding, selection, early return, PCS/MOS, try-out notification, Trial Camp packing, running program, leave and terminal leave answers given under Athletic Directors.)

## Coaches
**Q: What happens if I am selected to Coach?**

A: All-Marine Sports generates a selection message and sends it to each Marine selected. Each Marine will be responsible for creating their DTS authorization and signing it so that All-Marine Sports can approve the travel. Government Travel Charge Card use is mandatory for required travel and centrally billed accounts will not be authorized.

**Q: What are my responsibilities as a "Coach"?**

- Communicate and plan with All-Marine Sports office on all aspects of Trial Camp and Armed Forces Championships
- Review submitted applications. Marines must be Command approved to be considered for selection.
- In coordination with All-Marine Sports, select players and an assistant coach (if applicable) to attend Trial Camp from the application pool.
- Uphold the standards of the Marine Corps in all team activities at all times.
- Players shall receive counseling on a regular basis to ensure they are aware of strengths and weaknesses.
- Report injuries and incidents.
- At Trial Camp, the coach must coach or observe all practices/training and scrimmage games.
  - Coordinate with All-Marine Sports and Trial Camp host for practice/training needs and scrimmage games.
  - Release/cut players to return to their duty station and select players for the Armed Forces Championship roster.

**Q: What do I need to bring to Trial Camp?**

A: As the coach it is you're responsible to provide the specific requirements for each Trial Camp to the Marines selected prior to travel. In addition, each Marine is required to bring a pair of khaki pants, belt, and dress shoes.

**Q: Can I be the coach if I am on leave?**

A: No, participation while in a leave status is prohibited.

**Q: Can I coach while on Terminal Leave status?**

A: No, you have to be in an active status to participate.

**Q: I've filled out the application now what do I do?**

A: Based on the information provided on your application, All-Marine Sports will select candidates to participate in Trial Camp. (Make sure your application is complete, decisions are made based on what is on the application). Submitting an application does not guarantee selection to coach.

(The Coaches tab also repeats the policy, eligibility, sports offered, TAD funding, how to apply, application deadline and early return answers given above.)

## Commanders
**Q: What if I need a Marine back early from an All-Marine Sports competition?**

A: If you need a Marine back early for mission requirements, the All-Marine Sports Office will attempt to make travel arrangements to have the Marine back within 24 hours. This return cost may be the responsibility of the command.

(The Commanders tab otherwise repeats the policy, eligibility, PCS/MOS, TAD funding, try-out notification, Trial Camp selection, packing, leave and terminal leave answers given under Athletic Directors.)

# USAA St. Paddy's Engineer 5 Mile Challenge

This course was designed by US Marine Corps Engineers!

## Event Details
Date: March 14, 2026

Location: Ellis Field, Courthouse Bay

## Course Description
As you traverse the various terrains, you will encounter sandy tank trails, wooded trails, creeks, a sandbag carry, and a few obstacles thrown in just for fun!

## Important Information
- THIS IS AN UNTIMED EVENT
- Must be 10 years old or older to register
- No pets allowed

## Installation Access
**ALL RUNNERS AND ALL PASSENGERS (18YRS AND OVER) NEEDING A BASE PASS must complete the instructions below AFTER race registration has been completed.**

Due to the race being held aboard an active Marine Corps installation, all runners and spectators without a valid DoD ID with credentialed base access must obtain an Event Base Access Pass.

**Steps to Register:**

1. Register for a base pass at https://www1.mcieast.usmc.mil/IARA/
2. Locate the event and select "Request Sponsor"
3. Agree to the Privacy Act Statement
4. Select the Visitor Type dropdown and choose either driver or passenger
5. Complete the registration with required information:
   - **Drivers**: Social Security number, DOB, email, phone number, driver's license, auto insurance policy, and auto information
   - **Passengers**: Social Security number, DOB, government ID, email, and phone number

**Deadline**: 30 days prior to the event date.

**REAL ID Notice**

Effective immediately, all visitors with non-REAL ID driver's license and State issued identification cards requesting access to MCIEAST-MCB Camp Lejeune or MCAS New River must provide an approved identity source document or combination thereof.

Accepted identity documentation includes: U.S. passport, or the combination of an original or certified true copy of a birth certificate bearing a raised seal, social security card, and non-REAL ID compliant driver's license or State issued identification card (all three documents must bear the same name).

For questions on the REAL ID, contact Base Security at 910-450-0282.

pages.text:
# Tun Alley - Wine, Spirits, & More

At Tun Alley Wine, Spirits & More, we pride ourselves on serving the diverse needs of our military community with convenience, quality, and care.

This one-stop shop opens weekdays at 8AM, offering everything from your morning coffee and fresh grab-and-go breakfast to an extensive selection of wines, spirits, craft beers, and liquors.

Start your day with our freshly prepared breakfast options, stop by for a quick and satisfying lunch, or pick up that special bottle for your evening plans – all in one convenient location. Our early morning hours and comprehensive selection make us the perfect destination, no matter your schedule or needs.

## Special Orders
Need something special for an event, party, or the holidays? We can help!

From bubbly wine to ice-cold beer, we've got your favorites covered—because every event deserves the perfect pour!

• Wines may be ordered by the bottle.
• Beer must be ordered by the case.

## Wine Discounts
10% off when you purchase any 6 bottles of wine. Mix & match 750 ml or 1.5 L.

## Keg Club
For a $60 membership fee, you may have two kegs out at once and you can keep them for up to six months. If you have to relocate or decide to get out of the Keg Club, your $60 membership fee will be returned.

_Advance notice is required._
